title: Design System: Wisely AI Threat Intelligence

breakpoints.name: shell
breakpoints.purpose: Minimum desktop canvas. No mobile layout.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Modal and in-flow confirm (Add user, Run, Search).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary-base, #375dfb); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #256dec; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #525866; border: 1px solid #e2e4e9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f6f8fa; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #256dec; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Header CTA
components.description: Page-level create action with leading icon.
components.css: .ds-btn-header { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 14px 8px 12px; background: #256dec; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e4e9; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(228, 229, 231, 0.24); font: 400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.084px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-header:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-header:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #182230; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default 42px field on white with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0a0d14; } .ds-field span { color: #525866; } .ds-input { height: 42px; border: 1px solid #e2e4e9; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; padding: 10px 14px; font: 400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0a0d14; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #868c98; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #256dec; }

components.name: Sidebar Item Active
components.description: Active section in the 249px mint sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { height: 48px; width: 225px; padding: 0 0 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #1a1a1a; font: 500 16px/24px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.3125px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: #182230; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item:hover:not(.is-active) { background: #f6f8fa; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #256dec; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; font: 500 12px/16px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: White 12px panel on the mint floor.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e4e9; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0px 1px 1px rgba(228, 229, 231, 0.24); font: 400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0a0d14; } .ds-card header { padding: 12px 16px; background: #f6f8fa; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e4e9; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; padding: 16px; color: #525866; }

narrative.overview:
This is an operate surface for threat analysts: look up identifiers, manage API keys, and administer users. The visual world is a mint-paper operations floor with a navy chrome bar. Surfaces are white cards on a cool page, not a white-canvas SaaS template. Color is quiet except for one family of blues used as the action voice.

Density is desktop-first and scan-oriented. Tables, tabs, and labeled fields do the work. Ornament, illustration, and motion are not part of the language. Figma Handoff frames are the composition source; this file is the theme those frames are restyled into.
keyCharacteristics: Mint page (#ebf1f1) with navy top bar (#182230)
Blue for action, tabs, and focus — never as page fill
Status is a tinted pill, not a saturated block of color

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only loud color and it stays on actions, selection, and identity chips. Do not use it as a page, card, or table fill.

rules.name: The Mint Floor Rule
rules.body: White is a surface that sits on mint. A full-bleed white main pane is off-brand.

rules.name: The Narrow Band Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce 32px+ display type or a second family. Hierarchy is weight and color, not a new font.

rules.name: The Desk Width Rule
rules.body: Do not collapse the sidebar or invent a mobile nav. New screens assume the 1440 shell.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer stroke over a new shadow. Shadows appear on lifted surfaces (modals, tables), not on every tile.

rules.name: The 8/12 Rule
rules.body: Interactive chrome is 8px. Containing surfaces are 12px.

dos: Do keep new screens on the 1440 shell with the existing top bar and 249px sidebar.
Do restyle Figma frames into these tokens rather than copying TelDefence greys or hamburger chrome.
Do use Inter 14/20 for body UI and 24/32/600 for page titles.
Do put primary actions as blue buttons; put destructive actions as red text in menus, not red fills.
Do download icons from Figma and size them explicitly (16/20/24px). Reuse a project icon only when the glyph matches.
donts: Don't introduce Tailwind, a second typeface, or a dark-mode canvas.
Don't fill the page with primary blue. Blue is scarce.
Don't hand-draw SVG icons when a Figma export exists.
Don't use heavy drop shadows, gradients, or glass on cards.
Don't invent mobile breakpoints or collapse the sidebar.
Don't treat JSON playground styling as the default for forms.
